name: hunk
description: Review-first terminal diff viewer for agentic coders

issues.title: In-diff content search with match-to-match navigation
Support replying to inline agent comments and route replies back to the agent
Persist live comments so a Hunk review session can be continued after quit
Every invocation leaks a 3.6MB dylib into tmpdir
Expose Shiki's bundled themes (and custom theme files) via a top-level syntax_theme
Feature: Sidebar-based lazy Git staging & committing (à la lazygit)
Proposal: Streaming pager mode for `git log -p` and other large patch streams

latest_release.name: v0.25.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* docs(website): list hunk-workspace in the extension directory by @GopinathMR in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1204
* Remove the deprecated --fast flag by @masonmcelvain in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1207
* docs(release): publish 0.24.1 changelog by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1228
* chore(website): limit Vercel deployments to main by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1229
* fix(website): make brand logo downloads visible in any viewer by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1230
* fix(skills): fall back to hunk skill path in pointer skills by @ShryukGrandhi in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1220
* fix(ui): route text typed with Tab into the file filter by @ShryukGrandhi in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1221
* fix(ui): keep an open note draft mounted when a live reply arrives by @ShryukGrandhi in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1231
* fix(ui): window unwrapped diffs before viewport measurement by @squad-robert in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1241
* fix(extensions): share host runtime with file-symlinked entries by @squad-robert in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1240
* fix(ui): keep gap rows when a presentation scope retains every hunk by @squad-joey in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1239
* feat(website): balance the brand lockup and add a flat-mark lockup by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1242
* fix(git): spell UTC history dates the same on every Git version by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1247
* test(session): isolate broker tests from the real runtime dir by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1248
* Add hunk-viewed (RubenFricke) to hunk-extension marketplace by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1244
* fix(deps): upgrade shell-quote and zod past their advisories by @vuon9 in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1256
* feat(ui): preview changed images inline by @bottercode in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1210
* feat(gh): support GitHub Enterprise Cloud (ghe.com) hosts by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1264
* Add hunk-branch-toggle to hunk-extension marketplace by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1266
* Add hunk-go-review-filter to hunk-extension marketplace by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1252
* Add hunk-sort-by-path to hunk-extension marketplace by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1257
* Add hunk-glab to hunk-extension marketplace by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1261
* fix(keys): treat keypad navigation keys as their main-block equivalents by @liziye627-design in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1225
* fix(ui): start new notes on the selected note's line by @bottercode in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1263
* fix(extensions): give legacy sidebar views a mutable files copy by @RClaudiuM in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1267
* fix(watch): recover missing roots through exact parent events by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1269
* fix(bin): report unsupported Windows ARM64 fallback clearly by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1197
* fix(launcher): fall back to bundled Bun when the prebuilt binary cannot start by @pujitha24 in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1198
* build(deps): move to Pierre diffs 1.5.2 by @HackAttack in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1184
* fix(ui): compact menu labels before review titles by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/1094
* feat(ui): highlight active panes by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/993
* fix: keep one unparseable file from zeroing the whole review by @vkurilyak in https://github.com/modem-dev/hunk/pull/975
* feat(feedback): add `hunk feedback` and Help → Send feedback by @benvinegar in https://github.com/modem-dev/hu
